handoffTarget.note: The implementing engineer reads a running change log plus comments left on the Figma file. The log lives outside this repo and is the canonical copy — do not duplicate it here. Appended only on explicit request; see the changelog skill.

reviewRhythm: Batched. Feedback arrives as native Figma comments or as annotation pins from the running prototype, worked as a list via /design-feedback. Comments are never deleted or resolved by an agent.
